title: Probabilistic Error Analysis of Limited-Precision Stochastic Rounding: Horner's Algorithm and Pairwise Summation
summary: Stochastic rounding (SR) is a probabilistic rounding mode that mitigates errors in large-scale numerical computations, especially when prone to stagnation effects. Beyond numerical analysis, SR has shown significant benefits in practical applications such as deep learning and climate modelling. The definition of classical SR requires that results of arithmetic operations are known with infinite precision.
